title: Notice that the LED line really switched, on an independent pin, so the firmware can count and report it

interface.what: configure the sense pin (a plain input) and its detection (the interrupt, if the route uses one) once at boot
an atomic snapshot of the rising-edge count, the falling-edge count and the time of the last edge (the polled route also takes its look at the pin here)

hal_contract.name: sense_line
hal_contract.what: the line jumpered from the LED pin, read as a level each pass or as a pin change

hal_contract.name: sense_detect_registers
hal_contract.what: the registers that enable the detection: PCMSKn / PCICR / PCIFR (pin-change); none for the polled route (PINx / DDRx only) - from cited RegisterField rows

hal_contract.name: sense_pull
hal_contract.what: no pull-up: the pin is a wire from the LED line and is never driven by this build

hal_contract.name: edge_timestamp
hal_contract.what: the hal_millis() value at the last counted edge (the polled route: the pass that noticed it)

hal_contract.name: edge_counters
hal_contract.what: the rise/fall counters: written in the ISR and read under ATOMIC_BLOCK (pin-change), or written and read in the main loop (polled)

notes: fgm-5b 2026-10-18, laid out exactly like catoms/read-button (fgm-5a). The repo ignores *.json by default: these files are force-added.
